title: Spend fixed budget on reflection before search widening

body.signal: A failure the loop cannot fix by trying again; the model repeats the same mistake across generations.
body.failure_mode: Beam search (k=4, m=2, cap=5, plateau=2) produced a material paired gain in only 4/10 cases; the Sonnet-reflection arm was material in 9/10 (selected) and rescued the hardest case (anagram_pairs_count) from beam's -82.4 pp to +25.4 pp above the 10.81 pp case floor.
body.detection: Track whether consecutive candidates share a failure mode; if so, diagnosis beats another sample.
body.fix_strategy: Route persistent failures to the reflector for root-cause diagnosis and a targeted instruction, before widening search or raising the cap.
